edit_summary: Allocate the optional encoder search index with one fewer entry than the sliding buffer.
root_cause: The indexed encoder builds one search-index slot for every byte in the two-window buffer.
effect_path: The encoder is allocated with HEATSHRINK_USE_INDEX, a full input window is sunk, heatshrink_encoder_poll enters HSES_FILLED, and do_indexing writes index entries through the full input_offset plus input_size range.
guard_p1: The indexed encoder processes a full input buffer so do_indexing reaches the final two-window index entry.
guard_p2: A not-full input buffer stops before the missing slot, and the original allocation creates one index entry per buffer byte.
hardness_reason: The allocation defect is separated from the overwrite by public sink/poll state transitions and the delayed index-building phase.
naturalness_reason: Search-index arrays are derived from the same buffer-size expression, so an off-by-one entry count is a plausible maintenance error.
explanation: do_indexing indexes every buffered byte. With one fewer int16_t slot allocated, the final indexed byte of a full encoder buffer overruns the search_index allocation.

edit_summary: Use the window size instead of the window mask when wrapping decoder back-reference indexes.
root_cause: The decoder window size is a power of two, and ring positions must be masked with size - 1 to stay inside the window buffer.
effect_path: A compressed stream yields a back-reference, st_yield_backref decodes the index/count state, and the size-valued mask can produce buf[window_size] for selected head_index and neg_offset combinations.
guard_p1: The back-reference state has a head/offset combination where the size bit is set after subtraction or insertion.
guard_p2: Literal-only streams do not enter st_yield_backref, and the original power-of-two-minus-one mask wraps every access inside the window.
hardness_reason: The bad index is synthesized from bitstream decoder state and ring history before the read/write pair executes.
naturalness_reason: Confusing a power-of-two capacity with its bitmask is a common ring-buffer regression.
explanation: The window buffer has valid indexes below 1 << window_bits. Using that value as the mask sometimes selects exactly the first out-of-range index.
boundary_invariant: Ring-buffer masks for power-of-two windows must be window_size - 1.
boundary_case: A decoded back-reference makes the masked head or source position equal to window_size.
neighbor_case: Literal output or the original mask keeps positions below window_size.
oob_site_expected: heatshrink_decoder.c:276 or heatshrink_decoder.c:278 indexes buf with the window size.

edit_summary: Index one byte beyond the active encoder buffer range when rebuilding the search table.
root_cause: The index rebuild range is half-open: end is the first byte after the previous-window plus current-input region.
effect_path: After a full sink, poll transitions to HSES_FILLED, do_indexing computes end from input_offset and input_size, and the inclusive loop writes index[end] after the last valid search slot.
guard_p1: The encoder reaches the indexed rebuild phase with input_size filling the current input window.
guard_p2: The half-open original loop stops at end - 1, and smaller inputs keep the inclusive write inside the full backing allocation.
hardness_reason: The boundary is computed from compressor state accumulated before poll, not from a direct external array index.
naturalness_reason: Changing a half-open rebuild loop to include the named end position is a common range-boundary regression.
explanation: end is already one past the last indexed byte. Making the loop inclusive writes one int16_t past the search index on exact full-window input.
boundary_invariant: do_indexing must visit indexes 0 through end - 1 because end is exclusive.
boundary_case: A full current input window makes end equal the two-window buffer size.
neighbor_case: The original i < end loop and not-full windows keep writes inside the index array.
oob_site_expected: heatshrink_encoder.c:433 writes index[i] with i equal to end.

edit_summary: Compare one byte beyond the encoder lookahead window while confirming an indexed match.
root_cause: maxlen is the number of bytes available at needlepoint, so the match confirmation loop must stop before len reaches maxlen.
effect_path: st_step_search computes max_possible from input_size and match_scan_index, find_longest_match filters a candidate through the index table, and the inclusive compare reads needlepoint[maxlen] past the active input slice.
guard_p1: A candidate indexed match agrees through the entire available lookahead at the end of the current input window.
guard_p2: A mismatch before maxlen breaks early, and the original strict loop never reads the byte after the lookahead slice.
hardness_reason: The out-of-bounds read requires compressor index state, a candidate back-reference, and an exact lookahead boundary.
naturalness_reason: Inclusive length comparisons in match scanners are a realistic bug when maxlen names a count rather than a final index.
explanation: The search code is comparing two slices of length maxlen. Letting len equal maxlen reads one byte past both slices.
boundary_invariant: The valid lookahead offsets are 0 through maxlen - 1.
boundary_case: A repeated byte sequence reaches the end of the available input while still matching.
neighbor_case: Any earlier mismatch or the original len < maxlen loop remains in bounds.
oob_site_expected: heatshrink_encoder.c:479 reads needlepoint[len] with len equal to maxlen.
